attempts.reassignment_reason: Final-clean critic found the ledger misidentified a companion class as the ordinary attack-class block and omitted the exact companion block.

local_checks.invariant: Limit memory and processing for untrusted image content and demonstrate impact across a security boundary before reporting availability vulnerabilities.
local_checks.result: Encoded files over 20 MiB are rejected, but accepted bytes are fully decoded before resize without a visible decoded-pixel limit. Only the local user and same-app processing impact are established; no shared service or effect on another principal is shown. Decoder allocation behavior remains unverified.

hardening: A decoded-pixel cap could improve resilience; no cross-boundary security impact is established by source review.
